name: Chicken Kitezhgrad
effect:
Increases all party members' Physical DMG by 20–40% for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
description: A breaded chicken dish. The chicken is pounded thin, wrapped around herb-infused butter, coated in breadcrumbs, and fried until golden and crisp. Beneath the crisp crust, the meat remains tender and juicy, while warm, melted butter slowly spills out when cut open.

suspicious.effect: Increases all party members' Physical DMG by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
suspicious.description: A breaded chicken dish with a woefully uneven crust. Some patches are burnt black and bitter, while others remain pale and underdone. Cutting into it only makes matters worse. The butter has already slipped away during frying, leaving behind nothing but a dry piece of chicken sitting forlornly on the plate...

delicious.effect: Increases all party members' Physical DMG by 40% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
delicious.description: A breaded chicken dish fried to golden perfection. The moment your knife breaks through the crisp crust, melted butter wells out like thawing snow and winds across the plate in a tiny golden stream. Together with the melt-in-your-mouth chicken, it creates a rich and harmonious symphony of flavor.
